records.title: Knowledge Composition Engine and Management Structure Framework
records.implemented_scope: Roadmap Wave 3 is implemented as versioned declarative Planning Model and Knowledge Module registries, deterministic dependency resolution, explicit Reasoning Package V3 selection, Knowledge Package V2, generic Management Package V2 construction, provenance, completeness, governance, compatibility guards, observability, schemas, evaluation, documentation, package validation, and Drive-independent restoration.

records.title: Classification Intelligence Evolution
records.implemented_scope: Classification Intelligence Phase 1 is implemented and release-candidate packaged: responsibility-first classification, version 2 reasoning contract, evidence-aligned explainability, manager-intent inference, challenge lifecycle, shadow comparison, controlled routing modes, governed configuration, evaluation dataset, calibration tooling, compatibility projection, ADR, operating standard, observability, and regression coverage.

records.title: Responsibility-Based Classification
records.implemented_scope: Responsibility domain, outcome, workstream, and activity are modeled independently with governed precedence, evidence weights, confidence, safe fallback, compatibility projection, and people-leadership versus technical-activity fixtures.

records.title: Classification Explainability
records.implemented_scope: Every semantic decision produces structured decisive evidence and a concise evidence-aligned user explanation with ambiguity, challenge, correction, and fallback fields in the version 2 contract.

records.title: Manager Intent Inference Engine
records.implemented_scope: Operating-context inference is implemented for People Leader, Project Manager, Operations Manager, Strategic Planner, Individual Contributor, and Executive, with independent confidence, evidence, conflict handling, and supporting-signal-only enforcement.

records.title: Release-Gated Development Record Reconciliation
records.implemented_scope: Bidirectional release-to-Notion and Notion-to-release reconciliation, explicit dispositions, deterministic record digests, drift and missing-record detection, readback comparison, checksum-covered reports, fail-closed release gating, and a packaged post-promotion workflow dry run.

records.title: GitHub-First Authority Migration and Drive Dependency Reduction
records.implemented_scope: GitHub-first source and release authority is active in v5.4.0 with recursive Drive inventory and parent-closure contracts, checksum-bound representation requirements, fixed bootstrap and Drive allowlist enforcement, release publication/download/readback verification, and restoration without Drive.

records.title: Capability-Based ROS Architecture Migration and Numbered-Workflow Retirement
records.implemented_scope: Roadmap Waves 1 through 6 are implemented in the v6 candidate. Semantic capabilities are the sole runtime architecture; canonical reconciliation adds versioned field authority, conflicts, command idempotency, checkpoint safety, exact attended authorization, verified readback, and fail-closed receipts. Numbered runtime interfaces and aliases are retired from the wheel and source distribution. Migration, differential, restoration, and v5.6 rollback evidence are packaged.

records.title: Task Economy and Execution Projection Guardrails
records.implemented_scope: Roadmap Wave 4 is preserved through immutable Execution Candidate and Projection Decision contracts, provider-neutral Existing Representation Index, Execution Plan V2, deterministic candidate extraction, the complete 14-condition Task Projection Test, progressive horizons, duplicate and representation analysis, task budgets, decomposition review, over-compression safeguards, Done When quality, structured explainability, a 52-case benchmark, and property tests. Planning cannot authorize, import adapters, call providers, or emit receipts.

records.title: Enforce Todoist Done When bullet formatting at the write boundary

records.title: Todoist Section Routing by Management Domain
records.implemented_scope: Delivered in Atlas ROS v5.1 and preserved through the semantic command, orchestrator, and adapter boundary; management-domain routing is regression verified for v6.

records.title: Preserve Todoist parent-subtask hierarchy during section moves
records.implemented_scope: Delivered in Atlas ROS v5.1 and preserved by the Wave 5 Todoist adapter's parent, child, hierarchy, move-group, and immediate-readback operations; hierarchy remains regression verified for v5.6.
